robot_specification.joint_position_limit_note: Signed limits are unavailable in the selected source. Total travel does not establish joint zero or symmetry. The alternate PDF reports J6 travel of 450 degrees.

task_constraint.direction_label_zh: 向 -X、向下，低于水平 30 度
task_constraint.scenario_en: Curved-surface sanding from an upper-side station
task_constraint.estimate_rationale_zh: 假定协作臂从 +X 侧接近，40 度用于较宽作业方向试验；厂家只给出各轴总行程时，不猜测其有符号关节区间。

world_position_constraint.estimate_rationale_zh: 工作面中心水平偏置 0.75 m、相对底座安装面高度 0.4 m；圆形工作窗口半径 0.18 m。按名义臂展预留余量选取的布局初值，不是最大可达面积。移动工作面后须重新评估窗口。

task_constraint.note_zh: 方向锥、底座与工作窗口固定在用户世界坐标；移动工件不会自动移动这些约束。TCP 定义在实际工具的工作端；当前工具长度与安装姿态为估计，须用实际标定替换。

tcp_to_surface_distance_m.rationale_zh: 接触砂磨，TCP 定义在砂盘接触面；离面距离为 0。

base_pose_world.note_zh: 位置为底座安装面中心；估计底座 +X 指向工件的水平投影，+Z 向上，未做实物标定。

tcp_transform.note_zh: 假定直工具沿法兰 +Z，TCP 位于工作端（磨头接触面、探针尖端、针头、镜头前端或喷嘴）；实际夹具、工具及 TCP 须重新标定。

unmodeled: payload center of mass and inertia

sources.title: FANUC America CRX-10iA product specifications, consulted 2026-10-16
sources.note: The product page lists total travel, not signed q_min/q_max. J6 is listed as 380 degrees; a separate FANUC datasheet lists 450 degrees, so this value is source/version specific.

sources.title: FANUC America CRX-10iA PDF datasheet, alternate joint-6 travel
sources.note: This PDF lists J6 total travel as 450 degrees, unlike the product webpage. Do not turn either total span into a symmetric joint interval.

sources.title: Universal Robots manual: Operating Space
sources.note: Explains position-dependent orientation restrictions, outer reach and the central restricted cylinder. Does not prescribe the station offsets or work-window radii used here, including for other brands.
